messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

After the Expense Report is received, a new account must be created if the employee does not already have one. The report is then reviewed for automatic approval. Amounts under $200 are automatically approved, whereas amounts equal to or over $200 require approval of the supervisor. In case of rejection, the employee must receive a rejection notice by email. Otherwise, the reimbursement goes to the employees direct deposit bank account. If the request is not completed in 7 days, then the employee must receive an approval in progress email. If the request is not finished within 30 days, then the process is stopped and the employee receives an email cancellation notice and must re-submit the expense report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ExpenseProcess"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <bpmn:process id="ExpenseReimbursementProcess" name="Expense Reimbursement Process" isExecutable="true">

    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReportReceived" name="Expense Report Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_StartToAccountGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Account Verification Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasAccount" name="Employee has account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_StartToAccountGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_NoAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_HasAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Create Account Task -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateAccount" name="Create New Account">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_NoAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AccountCreated</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <!-- Account Merge Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_HasAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AccountCreated</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToAutoApprovalCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Review for Automatic Approval Task -->
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_ReviewAutoApproval" name="Review for Automatic Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToAutoApprovalCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToAmountGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>

    <!-- Amount Check Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountCheck" name="Amount Check">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToAmountGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_Under200</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_200OrMore</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Supervisor Approval Task -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SupervisorApproval" name="Supervisor Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_200OrMore</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToSupervisorApprovalGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Supervisor Decision Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" name="Approved by Supervisor?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToSupervisorApprovalGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_SupervisorApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_SupervisorRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Approval Merge Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_Under200</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_SupervisorApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToReimbursement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Direct Deposit Reimbursement Task -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Reimburse via Direct Deposit">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToReimbursement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToApprovedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <!-- Send Rejection Notice Task -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejectionNotice" name="Send Rejection Email Notice">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_SupervisorRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToRejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <!-- End Events for Normal Paths -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Reimbursed" name="Expense Reimbursed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToApprovedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Expense Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToRejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Boundary Non-Interrupting Timer (7 Days) -->
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_7Days" name="7 Days Elapsed" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="Task_SupervisorApproval">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To7DaysEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_7Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <!-- Send Approval In Progress Email Task -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProgressEmail" name="Send Approval In Progress Email">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To7DaysEmail</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProgressNoticeSent" name="Progress Email Sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ProgressEmailSent</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Boundary Interrupting Timer (30 Days) -->
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 Days Elapsed" cancelActivity="true" attachedToRef="Task_SupervisorApproval">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To30DaysEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <!-- Send Cancellation Email Task -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCancellationEmail" name="Send Email Cancellation Notice">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To30DaysEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToCancelledEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Cancelled" name="Process Stopped (Re-submit required)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToCancelledEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_StartToAccountGateway" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReportReceived" targetRef="Gateway_HasAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Task_CreateAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_HasAccount" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AccountCreated" sourceRef="Task_CreateAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToAutoApprovalCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewAutoApproval" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToAmountGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReviewAutoApproval" targetRef="Gateway_AmountCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Under200" name="Amount < $200" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount < 200}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_200OrMore" name="Amount >= $200" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountCheck" targetRef="Task_SupervisorApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount >= 200}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToSupervisorApprovalGateway" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorApproval" targetRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_SupervisorApproved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_SupervisorRejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejectionNotice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToReimbursement" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalMerge" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToApprovedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="EndEvent_Reimbursed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToRejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectionNotice" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To7DaysEmail" sourceRef="Timer_7Days" targetRef="Task_SendProgressEmail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ProgressEmailSent" sourceRef="Task_SendProgressEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_ProgressNoticeSent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To30DaysEmail" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Task_SendCancellationEmail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToCancelledEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendCancellationEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_Cancelled" />
